segments.title: Cold Open: Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as a dog, reclaiming his penis and initiating the live feed.

segments.title: Join the Wall: Descent into the Studio Drywall
segments.notes: Munch, building maintenance Dave, and electrician Gizbo enter the studio wall cavity, encountering Peter Gibbon, spectral former maintenance workers, rat gods, and a hellish transit authority managed by a deceased Crum; the party battles through RPG-style combat, retrieves Crum via hell key, and returns to the studio.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Viewer Thanks
segments.notes: Munch and Crum thank subscribers and bit donors while Crum raps over a swimmy beat; Crum reveals he is now dating Belilia and has a debate scheduled with a Republican influencer in late September.

segments.title: Raid Out to Sir Lar
segments.notes: Munch initiates a raid on Sir Lar of the Bite Boys after a botched raid command.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the station sign-on as a dog and opened the broadcast with a cold open from the control room.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Commandeered the broadcast as captain of the wall expedition, led the party through the drywall and hell, and closed the show with a rap wrap-up.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Encountered living in the studio wall cavity; revealed as a former producer fired multiple times who now haunts the drywall with a camera setup.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Found managing the hell transit authority after dying from the gorilla wager; reluctantly rescued via hell key and returned to the mortal plane.

characters.name: Dave
characters.notes: building maintenance. Accompanied Munch into the wall as the legitimate maintenance worker; gained hell powers and a hell key fused to his soul.

characters.name: Gizbo
characters.notes: Dwarf-warrior electrician with a robotic female voice; served as MVP combatant throughout the wall descent and hell battle.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical/cultural correspondent. Briefly empowered the party in hell with the power of straight cash (bits) and was revealed as Crum's ex-wife in hell.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: musical finale host. Referenced as the source of looping background music during the wall combat sequences.

storylines.beat: [02:31:32] Crum confirmed dead in hell, serving as assistant manager of the hell transit authority after losing the gorilla wager; rescued by Munch's hell key but retains gambling addiction and hell memories.

lore_notes.fact: Munch won a bet with the devil and received a hell key fused to his soul, enabling two-way travel to hell.
Peter Gibbon confirmed living permanently in the studio wall cavity with a full camera setup; claims the wall is an endless voluminous hallway.
Hell operates on opposite logic: everything is backwards, money only goes to the worst people, and Crum reverted to Christianity 'for the devil.'
Crum is now dating Belilia as of this broadcast.
Munch has a debate scheduled with a 'certain republican influencer' at the end of September and plans to suspend summer preparation.
Crum's penis was temporarily lost in hell but returned 'slightly smoother than usual.'
Munch stole Crum's debate points during the hell confrontation.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a special 'Join the Wall' event where debate analyst Munch led building maintenance Dave and electrician Gizbo into the studio drywall, uncovering a subterranean labyrinth inhabited by news stowaway Peter Gibbon, spectral rat gods, and a hellish transit authority managed by deceased debate analyst Crum. After RPG-style combat through the wall and a climactic battle in hell, the party retrieved Crum via a hell key fused to Munch's soul and returned to the studio, where Crum revealed a new relationship with Belilia and an upcoming debate against a Republican influencer.
